 "topology": "3-stage current-starved ring VCO with mirrored PMOS/NMOS starvation and a CMOS output buffer",
 "rationale": "The ring has 3 stages for speed. VCTRL drives an NMOS whose current runs through a PMOS diode, and both starve rails mirror that current with ratio k. A resistor in parallel sets a floor current so f_lo stays measurable. The buffer isolates the 10 fF load and restores rail-to-rail swing. Budget: two bias branches at about 20 uA each (72 uW) plus CV²f of about 260 uW at about 2 GHz, which stays under 500 uW."}

PARAMS = {
    "Ib":   (20e-6, 8e-6, 50e-6),   # bias-branch current at mid vctrl
    "k":    (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),        # starve mirror ratio
    "Lc":   (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),       # vctrl device L
    "Lm":   (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # mirror / starve L
    "gmp":  (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),       # pmos mirror gm/Id
    "gmn":  (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),       # nmos mirror gm/Id
    "R":    (300e3, 50e3, 2e6),     # floor-current resistor (sets f_lo)
    "Wn":   (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),       # ring inverter nfet W (pfet = 2x)
    "Wb":   (2.0, 0.6, 8.0),        # buffer nfet W (pfet = 2x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vlo, vhi = spec["vctrl_range"]
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-14)
    Ib, k, Lm = p["Ib"], p["k"], p["Lm"]

    # VCTRL transconductor: set W so that Id(vmid) = Ib minus the resistor floor current
    p0 = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], Lm, Ib, vds=0.9)
    iR = max(vdd - p0.vgs, 0.1) / p["R"]
    ic_mid = max(Ib - iR, 0.2 * Ib)
    ref = lut.op("n", 10.0, p["Lc"], vmid, vdd - p0.vgs)
    Wc = min(max(10.0 * ic_mid / max(ref["Id"], 1e-12), 0.42), 200.0)
    ilo = lut.op("n", Wc, p["Lc"], vlo, 0.9)["Id"] + iR
    ihi = lut.op("n", Wc, p["Lc"], vhi, 0.5)["Id"] + iR * 0.8
    ihi = min(ihi, 4 * Ib)   # PMOS diode headroom limits the top end

    # Mirrors
    p1 = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], Lm, Ib, vds=0.9)
    n1 = lut.size("n", p["gmn"], Lm, Ib, vds=0.9)
    nb_ = n1  # nmos diode reference
    ps = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], Lm, k * Ib, vds=0.3)
    ns = lut.size("n", p["gmn"], Lm, k * Ib, vds=0.3)

    Wn, Wp = p["Wn"], 2 * p["Wn"]
    Wbn, Wbp = p["Wb"], 2 * p["Wb"]

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    # Bias branch 1: PMOS diode, current from vctrl NMOS plus floor resistor
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", p0)
    n.M("MC", "pb", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wc, p["Lc"])
    n.R("RF", "pb", "vss", p["R"])
    # Bias branch 2: mirror into an NMOS diode
    n.dev("MP1", "nb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", p1)
    n.dev("MN1", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", nb_)
    # 3-stage starved ring
    N = 3
    nodes = ["r0", "r1", "r2"]
    for i in range(N):
        a, y = nodes[i], nodes[(i + 1) % N]
        n.dev(f"MPS{i}", f"sp{i}", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", ps)
        n.M(f"MPI{i}", y, a, f"sp{i}", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, 0.15)
        n.M(f"MNI{i}", y, a, f"sn{i}", "vss", "nfet", Wn, 0.15)
        n.dev(f"MNS{i}", f"sn{i}", "nb", "vss", "vss", ns)
    # Output buffer
    n.M("MBP", "vout", "r0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wbp, 0.15)
    n.M("MBN", "vout", "r0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wbn, 0.15)

    # Analytic prediction
    cpu = 1.6e-15  # F per um of W (gate + drain junction, L=0.15)
    cnode = cpu * (Wn + Wp) * 2.0 + 1e-15
    c0 = cnode + cpu * (Wbn + Wbp)
    ctot = 2 * cnode + c0

    def freq(i):
        ipk = k * i
        return ipk / (ctot * vdd) * 0.6   # 0.6 = edge-shape and vdsat derating

    f_mid, f_lo, f_hi = freq(Ib), freq(ilo), freq(ihi)
    cbuf = cl + cpu * (Wbn + Wbp)
    p_dyn = (ctot + cbuf) * vdd ** 2 * f_mid * 1.3   # 1.3 for short-circuit current
    power = vdd * 2 * Ib + p_dyn
    return n, {
        "f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
        "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
        "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
        "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo),
        "swing": 1.75, "power": power,
    }
